reason: A is the better-supported and more physically coherent comparison: it links Al/Si barrier-oxide formation versus Mn-driven outward diffusion and porosity to a direct, falsifiable test under identical exposure conditions. B is more quantitative but its central claim that ~5 at.% Al protects primarily by suppressing Cr/Mn cation diffusion is unsupported—and internally inconsistent because its Al alloy contains no Mn—while cited evidence suggests protective alumina may require Al above 5 at.%.
